metadata.description: Self-hosted Claude Code plugin marketplace for x_likes_downloader — operate the user's own X (Twitter) Likes via natural language.

plugins.name: x_likes
plugins.description: List and download media from your own X (Twitter) likes via natural language. Provides 4 slash commands (/x_likes:auth | list | setup | download) and an MCP server backed by the x_likes_downloader binary.
